## What happens today

`digest.py` prints the queued Capture whole. On the ten errand message that is ten lines, nine of
which are already filed, and the person has to find the one that is not.

## What to change

The partition from ticket 21 already says which piece is uncovered. The ask leads with that piece.
The rest of the Capture stays available as context, because a piece out of its message can be hard
to place, but it is not what the ask opens with.
